correctness.rationale: Exact equivariant two-particle cube complex has 120,336,228 cells. Signed boundary composition is zero. Mod-three rank of d2 is 208, with nine explicit graph-cycle lifts showing H1 has rank at least 9 and hence rational rank d2 at most 208, proving Betti ranks 1,9,20. Each of the 96 automorphisms is checked as a chain map, and signed-cell Lefschetz formulas give every degree-one and degree-two character value. Averaging over the full group and the canonical order-eight rotation group gives quotient invariant dimensions (0,0) and (2,2), respectively. Standard suitable-subdivision and rational transfer theorems are explicitly invoked, rather than assumed verified by code.

value.rationale: This 16-vertex, 24-edge canonical symmetric nonplanar incidence graph provides an exact two-degree equivariant configuration-homology benchmark. The substantive symmetry phenomenon is that both H1 and H2 retain two classes under canonical eightfold rotations but neither has a class fixed by all 96 automorphisms, producing rationally acyclic full quotient. These group-action facts are not supplied by known Betti ranks and bear directly on geometric symmetry quotients.
